appraisal_events.evidence: Françoise, à qui on pouvait parler du génie de Napoléon ou de la télégraphie sans fil sans réussir à attirer son attention... s'écriait : « C'est beau ça ! » et restait éblouie comme devant un vitrail
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator ironically characterizes Françoise as indifferent to genuine intellectual achievement but naively dazzled by trivial titles of nobility, a gently mocking class-based sketch.

status_effects.explanation: Her credulous fascination with noble titles, contrasted with indifference to real achievement, positions her mildly as a figure of gentle narratorial irony.
